historical_reviews.deepseek: Covers only insertion, uses unsafe transport/credentials and invents an installation flow that the source does not authorize.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly scopes acceptance to mount plus boot from media and separates any disk-writing OS installation into another explicit approval.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Inserted is control-plane state, not proof that the host can read or boot the intended bytes. Evidence must bind immutable image identity through BMC readback to one-time boot and an observed pre-install boot landmark.

original_test_intent: Validate that the approved BMC virtual-media image can be mounted and used as the SUT's controlled boot source without performing an unapproved OS installation or leaving boot state changed.
original_method: Verify target, VirtualMedia resource and baseline boot state; authenticate and hash an immutable compatible image; obtain approval, mount it through the protected supported path and read back exact identity; set only a one-time boot override, obtain reboot approval, observe POST and a defined pre-install image landmark, then stop, eject media, clear the override, boot the original OS and verify platform health.
manual_activity: The owner approves the exact image and boot-only boundary; an operator confirms POST/console boot identity, prevents installer disk writes and controls eject, restoration and recovery.
required_inputs: Approved immutable boot image and purpose
Protected image hosting and validated TLS
Current boot mode/order and one-time override schema
Defined observable boot landmark before any install
Maintenance window and final reboot approval
Media eject and original-boot restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Do not use an unverified mutable HTTP image
Do not expose credentials or bypass TLS
Do not infer boot success from Inserted alone
Use one-time boot, never silently rewrite persistent order
Obtain separate approvals before insertion and reboot
Stop before any installer or disk-write action unless separately authorized
Stop on wrong image/target, boot loop, timeout or detach failure
Eject and restore original boot before closure
Preserve logs and do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate image identity, integrity and compatibility
Mount and read back one approved image after confirmation
Set/read back one-time boot and reboot after confirmation
Collect structured status while operator proves POST/console boot landmark
Eject, restore and verify health under operator control
engineer_actions: Approve target, image, boot-only boundary and maintenance window
Give final mount and reboot approvals
Observe boot and stop any unapproved installer

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: InsertMedia and readback are partial evidence only; the literal command bypasses TLS, exposes credentials, uses mutable HTTP media, hardcodes a resource and does not set/observe boot, eject or restore.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the discovered vendor VirtualMedia resource with protected TLS/credentials, immutable image identity and structured readback; pair it with approved one-time boot and independent console observation, then eject and restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Mount and boot-from-media acceptance plus 10/10-minute estimates remain; OS installation is not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an evidence chain from image hash and protected source to BMC media readback, one-time boot state, POST device selection and a known non-writing image landmark, followed by detach and baseline restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects navigation and adds image assurance, observable boot boundary and cleanup without expanding into installation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Mount readback establishes attachment only; it does not prove host readability, boot selection or safe return to the original OS.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A bootable installer can overwrite disks automatically, and stale boot overrides or attached media can affect later reboots even after this check appears complete.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the image, resource, boot landmark and whether any installation is a separate testcase. The source's SOL-console navigation label does not change the VirtualMedia target.
expected_evidence: Approved target/window, boot baseline, VirtualMedia resource, immutable image hash/signature and compatibility
Protected insert request and readback binding exact image/resource/media state
One-time boot write/readback, reboot/POST timeline and console proof of the defined image boot landmark
Proof no unauthorized installer/disk write occurred
Eject readback, consumed/cleared override and original OS boot restoration
BMC/SUT/OS health, audit/SEL/OS logs, recovery actions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires virtual-media mount and boot. The SOL-console navigation wording is a clear path-label defect, not an alternative test target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The image, schema, boot landmark and recovery package are normal project inputs that can be requested; no source intent must be guessed to review the case.

review_improvement: Preserves the mount-and-boot objective while forbidding the invented unattended installation and requiring a reversible, identity-bound boot proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: VirtualMedia has three distinct states: the BMC accepted an image reference, the host firmware enumerated the media, and execution transferred to bytes from that image. Only an evidence chain across all three proves the criterion. Stopping at a non-writing image landmark prevents boot validation from silently becoming a storage-destructive installation test.
